note: The bands the AeroTetris C-130 Hercules 3077 plant has to land in, from docs/HERCULES-STAGE1.md, which derives each from AeroTetris's published figures, the full size C-130H scaled to the kit, E-flite's for the Power 25 and APC's for the 12 x 8E (scripts/hercules-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Kadet's in proportion about its derived figure, as the Kadet's are the Bombshell's. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

h1_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 9.67 at 6.728 kg on the kit's 104.86 dm^2 and CLmax 1.10; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.10 / 5.688, of the zero lift line

h2_cruise.source: level speed at 75 percent of the throttle stick, derived 17.36, the Kadet's cruise stick; the scale pace of 1.6 Vs, 15.5 m/s, is flown at 70 percent. Derived 21.35 since then, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8E curve (prop curves, npm run prop:curves -- wings), was 17.36 on the straight line; the Kadet's proportion about it, 0.860 to 1.165, rounded in.

h3_glide.source: power off at 1.25 Vs, 12.08 m/s: L/D derived 12.43, a sink of 0.97 m/s, on the component build up's CD0 0.0343

h4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 23.46. Derived 28.64 since then, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8E curve (prop curves, npm run prop:curves -- wings), was 23.46 on the straight line; the Kadet's proportion about it, 0.910 to 1.123, rounded in.

h5_takeoff.source: full throttle on grass from standing, the wings held on the ailerons and the heading on the rudder, the elevator eased up from 1.1 Vs: it lifts off between 1.1 and 1.5 Vs, and between the rolls to those speeds at the rest attitude, 7.06 and 15.80 m (hercules:derive). The rolls are 5.59 and 11.19 m since then, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8E curve (prop curves, npm run prop:curves -- wings), was 7.06 and 15.80 on the straight line; the liftoff speeds, 1.1 and 1.5 Vs, are the wing's and do not move.

h6_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, level, the CG 0.2604 m up and 10.75 percent of the weight on the nose wheel (hercules:derive), within half a degree, 5 mm and a fifth of the share, the Kadet's

h9_doors.source: O in level cruise at 75 percent: the ramp and door open in their 4 s, and the open hold and ramp's drag, 0.0259 on the wing (hercules:derive, ESTIMATED from Hoerner's base drag and plate), slow the level speed to a derived 15.86 m/s, 1.50 under H2's; the band H2's in proportion, the drop within a third. An aircraft without doors refuses them. Derived 19.49 m/s open, 1.85 under H2's 21.35, since then, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8E curve (prop curves, npm run prop:curves -- wings), was 15.86 and 1.50 on the straight line; the band H2's proportion about it, rounded in, and the drop within a third, 1.24 to 2.47.

h7_unmoved.source: every other aircraft's recorded flight hash, as tests/kadet-thresholds.json s17_unmoved and tests/extra-thresholds.json hold them: adding airframe 31 moves none. The Extra's own is the value tests/nighttimber-thresholds.json n15_unmoved holds on main, since #924 took the Extra's built in wing drop out (was 0f83ca1d4abb18e1 at d9ee87f0)

h8_cross_host.source: the Hercules' recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
